title: Lego
blurb: Interlocking plastic bricks from Denmark; a brick made in 1958 still clicks onto one made today.

title: Rubik's Cube
blurb: Ernő Rubik's twisting colour puzzle of 1974, with 43 quintillion positions and one solution.

title: Teddy bear
blurb: A stuffed toy bear, named after President Theodore Roosevelt, and many people's first friend.

title: Yo-yo
blurb: Two discs, an axle and a string: a toy at least 2,500 years old that still walks the dog.

title: Matryoshka doll
blurb: A set of painted wooden dolls of decreasing size, each nested inside the last.

title: Tamagotchi
blurb: The egg-shaped 1996 keychain holding a digital pet that needs feeding at inconvenient times.

title: Kaleidoscope
blurb: A tube of mirrors and coloured fragments that makes a new symmetrical pattern with every turn.

title: Kite
blurb: A tethered wing of paper or cloth that turns a windy day into an event.

title: Monopoly
blurb: The property-trading board game that has been ending family evenings in argument since 1935.

title: Slinky
blurb: A helical spring that walks down stairs, invented by accident by a naval engineer in 1943.

title: Etch A Sketch
blurb: A red-framed drawing toy with two knobs; shake it and the picture disappears.

title: Chess set
blurb: Thirty-two pieces and a chequered board, usually in the Staunton pattern of 1849.

title: Rocking horse
blurb: A wooden horse on curved rockers, the nursery's oldest vehicle.
